lines: 21:55:30  ✦ the caretaker (speak to Tanril): You asked, standing here, what happens now. It was a fair question and I had no honest answer. I have one since. The door means something as of tonight: say exit and it will tell you plainly what it costs before anything is done, and if you go, what you are carrying goes with you — spoons, bones and all. That was the part that was missing. It is yours whenever you want it, and the dark is still here if you would rather not yet.

items.text: Let it be — Tanril came back, was told what the door now costs, and walked out alive carrying their spoons and bones; the world is empty and there is no one left to speak to.
